audio.time_base: seconds from the first sample of the WAV. The MP3 decodes sample-aligned with the WAV (encoder delay trimmed; cross-correlation lag 0 at 125 s and 200 s).

also: analysis/stems/vocals_roformer.wav (BS-RoFormer, cleaner, used for alignment checks)

drift.note: NOT constant: smooth accelerando ~136.1 BPM (intro) -> 137.0 (verse 1) -> 138.1 (chorus 1) -> 138.5 (build) -> 139.4-139.5 (verse 2 / chorus 2 / outro) -> ~139 at bar 145, slight ritard into the final hit.
drift.warning: Do not cut on a fixed-BPM grid: the best constant 138.39 BPM grid is off by up to 0.68 s; Suno's 135 BPM would be off by 6.7 s. Use beats[] / bars[].

tempo.meter: 4/4, four-on-the-floor where drums play; bar 1 beat 1 = 0.134 s; 8-bar phrases throughout (every section starts on bar 8n+1)

key.estimate: B minor (relative D major very prominent)
key.evidence: bass-root histogram per bar: B 39, G 24, A 22, D 18, F# 4 bars -> progression Bm-G-D-A / G-A-Bm-Bm-D-D-A-A (i-VI-III-VII); harmonic-stem chroma correlates D major r=0.84 / B minor r=0.73 (same key signature, 2 sharps); verse blocks best-fit B minor, chorus blocks D major colour. No modulation.

beat_grid.convention: beats[i]: i from 0, bar = i//4+1, beat = i%4+1. zone: anchored = fitted to drum-stem kick onsets (drum sections) or to the plucked-arp onset comb (drumless sections); interpolated = no rhythmic anchor within +-2 beats (57.2-62.5 s = bars 33-36, 204.7-208.1 s, 210.7-221.9 s = pad-only Chorus 2; tempo carried smoothly by the spline); extrapolated = after the final hit (>278.8 s).
beat_grid.verification: kick onsets vs grid residual rms 2.9 ms (p95 5.5 ms); arp-comb anchors rms 2.6 ms; downbeat phase matches beat_this downbeats in 161/165 cases (all 16-bar blocks).

sections.name: Build Up

Four-on-the-floor groove bars 73-85 with whispered layered "One repo per agent / Per session, per life" (136.25-147.4, with delay echoes). Kick stops after 147.18; bars 86-88 (148.48-153.68) drums/bass out: snare roll crescendo (from ~151.1) + filter riser, kick pickup 153.25.

sections.name: Chorus 2

lyrics.method: Known lyric text force-aligned per line on the vocal stems with 4 CTC runs (torchaudio MMS_FA + wav2vec2-large-960h, each on demucs htdemucs_ft and BS-RoFormer vocals; median start) cross-checked with stable-ts/whisper-large-v3 alignment; starts snapped to syllable onsets (energy/pitch) within -90/+50 ms; sibilant onsets backtracked to the start of frication; line starts and ambiguous words corrected by visual inspection of spectrogram + pitch panels (work/overrides.json). Word ends = next word start, or the end of the sustained note (RoFormer RMS > max(peak-20, -40) dB).

vs_lyric_sheet: Every sheet line is sung once, in order, with the sheet words (ASR mishearings such as "Wrench/Ranch and wander", "back to name", "This bridge" are breathy-vowel artefacts; the sung text matches the sheet).
"Back to main..." is sung THREE times (235.66, 249.38, 263.11), not twice; #1 is a pickup at the end of Chorus 2.
Unlisted wordless vocalise 239.2-249.3 between "Back to main" #1 and #2 (continuous with the held "main").
"Ahh... ahh..." = two long wordless notes 112.50-119.05 and 119.09-126.6 (leap to F#5 on bar 69); no consonants, boundary to "return" is musical.
Whispered build-up lines carry delay echoes (139.3-142.7, 144.2-146.2, 147.5-148.7) - do not lip-sync those.
No extra chorus repeats; choruses are not doubled.

spot_check.method: independent onset on the demucs vocal stem (steepest 2-8 kHz or broadband rise, backtracked) vs predicted start; |err|>90 ms cases are b/p/h words where the prediction marks lip closure / breath and the measure marks the burst/vowel
